author: OldManTigerMask
body:
Username:
OldManTigerMask

Reason I was banned:
I was banned for MAP STEALING. I understand it was bad and that I shouldn't of done it. I also realize now that it is plagiarism and shall not do it again. 

Reason I should be unbanned:

I believe I should be un-banned as for I have been banned for more than a year and I now know what I'm supposed to do. I apologize for my immaturity a long time ago (about a year ago). I am sad and depressed that I no longer get to play on this network and I wish I could join again. 
Before you deny this I understand, I have ban-evaded and have been caught. But I haven't for the previous year so I think I've done enough time to be unbanned besides I am very sorry and wish to be unbanned. I hope that you will unban me and even if you just think eh, he Ban-Evaded your gonna not be accepted. Really I doubt that it should count as for I haven't played for more than a year.

I plead again to be unbanned even if I don't get unbanned I'll still remember this server.

- OldManTigerMask
